description: Critical-obligation coverage for compact runtime task modules. Markers identify the mapping; operative prose anchors prove that mapped obligations remain present. This is a narrow drift gate, not a full semantic parity mechanism.

common_precondition.summary: Every compact runtime task module runs after the project contract is loaded and consults canonical or state files when authority or current state can affect the task.

ARB-approval-before-review.summary: Confirm User or SOW authorization before convening independent review or a panel.

ARB-read-only-launch-envelope.summary: Record a bounded read-only reviewer or panel launch envelope.

ARB-independent-panel-responses.summary: Keep panel responses independent until all responses are submitted.

ARB-no-decision-boundary.summary: No-majority, abstention, insufficient-evidence, and unavailable-seat outcomes do not create decisions.

ARB-ratification-boundary.summary: Binding effect requires User or SOW-named owner ratification unless expressly delegated.

ARB-post-blind-evidence-boundary.summary: Post-blind evidence review is authorized, trigger-bound, evidence-directed, and does not update locked votes.

ARB-challenge-packet-sanitization.summary: Coordinator challenge packets exclude identities, vote tallies, hidden reasoning, provider traces, and majority pressure.

ARB-evidence-correction-remand.summary: Revised voting after corrected evidence or rule material requires User or SOW-named owner authorization and sealed independent responses.

ARB-neutral-coordinator.summary: An interested position-holder cannot be the sole unchecked arbitration coordinator.

ARB-approval-before-review.operative_anchor: Confirm current User approval or explicit SOW standing authorization before convening a reviewer or panel.

ARB-read-only-launch-envelope.operative_anchor: Record the reviewer launch envelope: read-only workspace or snapshot

ARB-independent-panel-responses.operative_anchor: keep panelists isolated from each other's responses, votes, deliberation, and coordinator summaries until after all panel responses are submitted.

ARB-no-decision-boundary.operative_anchor: A no-majority, abstain, or insufficient-evidence result produces no recommendation and no operative decision unless the User or SOW-named owner decides directly.

ARB-ratification-boundary.operative_anchor: binding effect is ratified by the User or SOW-named owner unless the SOW expressly delegates it within a defined scope

ARB-post-blind-evidence-boundary.operative_anchor: Run post-blind evidence review only when the SOW or current User approval authorizes it

ARB-challenge-packet-sanitization.operative_anchor: Do not share identities, model/provider names, seniority markers, raw vote counts

ARB-evidence-correction-remand.operative_anchor: Open an Evidence Correction Remand only after User or SOW-named owner authorization

ARB-neutral-coordinator.operative_anchor: If the active Agent holds a position, authored a disputed recommendation, or has another material stake, use a fresh neutral agent or the User/SOW-named owner

AUDIT-coverage-ledger.summary: Broad or partitioned audits keep a coordinator-owned coverage ledger.

AUDIT-shared-runtime-verifier-ownership.summary: Partitioned audits centralize global verification, shared-state mutation or cleanup, non-isolated stateful work, and material bounded-resource contention without serializing ordinary isolated project-scoped commands or cleanup confined to worker-owned outputs.

AUDIT-schema-classification.summary: Material findings and open probes use the finding schema.

AUDIT-remediation-gated.summary: Fixes and state-file edits require remediation or state maintenance scope.

AUDIT-verification-gap-disclosed.summary: Relevant verification runs, or the gap is disclosed.

AUDIT-coverage-ledger.operative_anchor: For partitioned audits, keep a coordinator-owned coverage ledger with reviewer, evidence, findings, rejected/deferred claims, and validation status.

AUDIT-shared-runtime-verifier-ownership.operative_anchor: Coordinator or named-verifier ownership applies to global builds, full tests, packaging, benchmarks, global or shared-state cleanup, operations that mutate shared runtime, lifecycle, cache, or index state, other non-isolated stateful operations, and work that materially contends for a bounded shared resource; ordinary isolated project-scoped commands, including cleanup confined to worker-owned outputs, are not serialized merely because they execute in the same runtime.

AUDIT-schema-classification.operative_anchor: Load `runtime/finding_schema.json`; use its fields, enums, and conditional constraints.

AUDIT-remediation-gated.operative_anchor: fix them only when remediation is explicitly in scope or approved.

AUDIT-verification-gap-disclosed.operative_anchor: Run relevant verification commands only when authorized and feasible.

AUTO-authority-boundaries.summary: Recurring work records objective, allowed effects, autonomy, and standing grants before enablement.

AUTO-instruction-sources.summary: Reusable automation procedure is loaded through declared instruction sources, not copied into scheduler prompts.

AUTO-external-packet-default-deny.summary: External reviewer jobs use an explicit typed data boundary that denies sensitive and unlisted data.

AUTO-loop-stop-controls.summary: Looped work has progress, budget, no-progress, and escalation stops.

AUTO-scheduler-side-effects-gated.summary: Rendering, installing, and enabling scheduler jobs are separate authorized effects.

AUTO-standing-authority-source.summary: Standing automation creation or revision consults canonical approval, external-system, VCS, source-acquisition, and automation terms before jobs are defined or changed.

AUTO-authority-boundaries.operative_anchor: Every enabled job declares `authority`: allowed action and resource references, grant basis

AUTO-instruction-sources.operative_anchor: Keep scheduler prompts thin; do not duplicate framework procedure into each scheduled job.

AUTO-external-packet-default-deny.operative_anchor: sensitive and unlisted data are denied.

AUTO-loop-stop-controls.operative_anchor: For looped work, require a progress metric, maximum iterations or elapsed time, rate or cost cap

AUTO-scheduler-side-effects-gated.operative_anchor: Rendering into the project root, installing, or enabling the schedule is a separate authorized effect.

AUTO-standing-authority-source.operative_anchor: Because automation creates or revises standing authority, consult `STATEMENT_OF_WORK.md` for canonical approval

IDEATE-competing-approaches.summary: Consider competing viable approaches before ranking.

IDEATE-evidence-and-unknowns.summary: Record supporting evidence, contradicting evidence, and unknowns.

IDEATE-escalate-source-or-safety.summary: Use the full order when external sources, living standards, or evidence tradeoffs matter.

IDEATE-competing-approaches.operative_anchor: Generate multiple competing approaches before ranking them.

IDEATE-evidence-and-unknowns.operative_anchor: Record supporting evidence, contradicting evidence, and unknowns for each.

IDEATE-escalate-source-or-safety.operative_anchor: Switch to the full Task Order when external sources, living standards, or unresolved evidence tradeoffs matter.
IDEATE-escalate-source-or-safety.full_order_anchor: Prefer primary sources over secondary. Flag evidence gaps explicitly.

PLAN-no-unapproved-execution.summary: Plan-only requests do not execute without explicit implementation authorization.

PLAN-proof-per-slice.summary: Each work slice has concrete verification.

PLAN-hold-points.summary: Approval, architecture, and evidence hold points are explicit.

PLAN-no-unapproved-execution.operative_anchor: Do not execute the plan unless the User explicitly asks for implementation.

PLAN-proof-per-slice.operative_anchor: Attach exact verification to each slice.

PLAN-hold-points.operative_anchor: Add hold points for approvals, unresolved architecture, or missing evidence.

REVIEW-evidence-scope.summary: Use the smallest justified evidence scope before widening.

REVIEW-schema-and-open-probes.summary: Use the finding schema and route unsupported hypotheses to Open Probes.

REVIEW-remediation-gated.summary: Do not fix or edit state files unless remediation or state maintenance is in scope.

REVIEW-multi-agent-validated.summary: Coordinator validates external or multi-agent claims before final findings.

REVIEW-evidence-scope.operative_anchor: Choose the smallest justified Evidence Scope.

REVIEW-schema-and-open-probes.operative_anchor: Put consequential unresolved hypotheses in Open Probes, not Findings.

REVIEW-remediation-gated.operative_anchor: Report findings only unless remediation is explicitly in scope or approved; TODO/state edits also require scope or approval.

REVIEW-multi-agent-validated.operative_anchor: If multiple AI reviewers or external AI reports are used, coordinator must dedupe, source-check, reload evidence, preserve dissent, and validate claims before final findings.
